g.text: Navy and blue carry the interface. Red, amber and green are
kept for status only, so a chart segment is never mistaken for
an alert. Tap a swatch to copy its hex.
8.25 → 16.5px scale, set at 0.75× the desktop spec so operators see
clicks from a spike to the failing BTS
max drift in customer share after
Design the data before the UI
Profiling the columns first told me which charts mattered and which filters
A red “sample data” banner and an “AI not connected yet” note build more
Keeping red, amber and green for status made alerts readable at a glance.
Virtualized rows and page-sized scans are why 100K records feel instant.
